cardData.t62: Until rather recently, the church had stepped back from performing true exorcisms. Now, though? Good luck finding a priest without a nail.
cardData.t30: {Star}**CONTRACT:** Place a nail on target Beastie. {Star}**ARENA:** {I:Beasties with a nail on them have all ARENA Effects and Powers nullified.} Nullify all {Immortal} and {Spectral}.
